chunk-001:c004.proposition: Naturalism does not gain a comparative advantage from biological pain and pleasure when the invoked evolutionary processes are shared background knowledge or are themselves left unexplained by naturalism.

chunk-001:c005.proposition: Significant suffering can be expected on theism because it enables love-manifesting virtues such as courage, compassion, sacrifice, generosity, empathy, and forgiveness, while permitting suffering to be integrated into a valuable life as a whole.

chunk-001:c006.proposition: Even if naturalism predicts the suffering data and the soul-building account fails, limited human access to divine reasons warrants agnosticism about the probability of those data on theism and blocks comparative confirmation.

chunk-002:chunk002-candidate-03.proposition: The biological orientation of other bodily systems does not by itself establish that pain and pleasure should be biologically oriented on naturalism, especially when pain and pleasure necessarily have moral significance and admit a plausible moral-role alternative.

chunk-002:chunk002-candidate-04.proposition: Horrendous suffering does not defeat soul-building absent evidence that it permanently destroys persons, because severe hardship may be transformed or eventually defeated within a whole-life and afterlife account that can also extend to sentient animals.

chunk-002:chunk002-candidate-05.proposition: Skeptical theism rests on insufficient information rather than favorable unknown reasons, so a small and potentially unrepresentative sample of known considerations cannot justify the required probability judgment about evil on theism.

chunk-002:chunk002-candidate-10.proposition: Languishing and resource deprivation can create opportunities for sacrifice and communal moral growth, while naturalism supplies no sufficiently precise competing prediction to show that these conditions comparatively favor it over theism.
